In [[3956 BBY]] a '''series of rebellions''' took place on the fringe of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] territory. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] was sent to help end the rebellion, shortly after graduating the [[Sith Academy (Dromund Kaas)|Sith Academy]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Scourge managed to end the rebellions through his pursuit of the rebel leaders and his martial skills. [[3954 BBY|Two]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later Scourge returned to Dromund Kass to help solve the [[Assassination attempts on Darth Nyriss|assassination attempts]] on [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Nyriss]]' life.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial fringe rebellions was first mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]].
